long_biography.plain_text:
In 2003, Cauchi became the first Maltese national to manage the Westin Dragonara, after two decades in hotel sales, food and beverage, rooms and property leadership. His subsequent assignments ranged from Sardinian resorts and Corinthia's London opening to Velaa Private Island and Private Estates Saudi Arabia. He also chaired a Malta Tourism Authority marketing directorate.

Cauchi shifted into ownership through Patronus and a series of aviation transactions. He and Brendan McQuaid purchased US Alliance Flight Support in 2014, while the developing group later added AllianceJet and a Maltese air-operator certificate. Hans Jet followed. His next venture, Hans People, recruited staff for luxury hospitality, leisure and travel employers.
